description:
This master programme trains public-health professionals for disaster preparedness and response, covering risk governance, emergency operations and health-system resilience. Its admission-and-selection page carries the live dates and criteria for the next intake.

Programme Highlights

  • Public-health focus on disasters, crises and health-system resilience
  • Interdisciplinary faculty spanning epidemiology and emergency management
  • Admission criteria and dates published on the official page
  • Careers in health ministries, WHO-type agencies and humanitarian health teams

Who Should Apply

Public health, medicine, nursing and emergency-management graduates and professionals are the intended cohort.

Funding and Costs

Funding options depend on the current call; the admission page lists participation costs and any available support. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Review the admission-and-selection-criteria page and prepare the document set listed there for the live cycle. Key deadline information: Admission and selection dates published on the official admission-criteria page.
